name: Contractor Foreman
summary: Construction management (estimating, scheduling, daily logs and financial tracking), priced per company rather than per seat, with unlimited projects on every tier.
best_for: small and mid-size contractors who want estimating, scheduling and daily logs in one place and can commit to a year: the company-wide fee makes it cheap per head once you have a crew
skip_if: you are a sole trader with a handful of jobs, because Basic at $49 a month annual is real money against a spreadsheet and a calendar, though the 30-day trial and the conditional 100-day refund mean trying it costs nothing but your time
honest_knock: Credit where it is due first: this is company pricing with unlimited projects and no per-user overage inside your tier, which is rare in construction software and cheaper than per-seat rivals for a crew. The catch is the billing term. Monthly costs 20% to 32% more than annual on the same plan, $139 against $105 on Standard, and Basic is sold on annual billing only, so the cheapest way in requires a year paid up front. The user counts are the real ladder: 1, 3, 8, 15, unlimited. A five-person crew is not on Standard at $105, it is on Plus at $166, so count your licence holders before you compare against anything else.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · per month billed annually for the whole company with 1 user
pricing.notes: (re-verified 20 Nov 2026 on their own pricing page: annual and monthly prices unchanged since 11 Oct 2026, annual prices unchanged since 1 Aug 2026; the quarterly option recorded on 28 Aug 2026 has been replaced by monthly billing) Priced for the company rather than per seat, with unlimited projects on every tier, and annual plans open with 30 days free before the first bill; monthly plans are charged at sign-up. Annual: Basic $49/month ($588 a year, 1 user), Standard $105 ($1,264, 3 users), Plus $166 ($1,997, 8 users), Pro $221 ($2,654, 15 users), Unlimited $332 ($3,984, unlimited users). Monthly billing costs more for the same plans: Standard $139, Plus $199, Pro $279, Unlimited $399 a month; Basic is 'Available for Annual' only. The page's 'Save' figures match twelve monthly payments against the annual total: $404, $391, $694 and $804. Their own wording: the fee listed is the fee for the company as a whole. Card payments taken through the built-in Stripe integration are billed separately at 2.9% + $0.30 a transaction (3.9% + $0.30 for Amex, 1% + $0.30 capped at $10.00 for ACH).

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Contractor Foreman in the 30-day Basic annual trial that we started with our card. An estimate, a project and a task took about 4 minutes, but Basic has no daily log or scheduling module. The trial is set to bill $588 for a year, which the Paddle e-mail showed as $711.48 including tax. Cancelling in the app took four screens and a survey and keeps the trial until 19 December. Account and start: we created the account and started the 30-day trial of the Basic annual plan with his own card (Charged at End of Trial, Total Charged Today $0.00); a phone number was required at sign-up and we entered it. Our AI assistant ran the test in our browser on 19 November 2026 from 14:13. The interface was in English. The Account Setup popup asked required questions (accounting software, invoicing type, experience, help with set-up) and a Job Function; then a guide created a test customer and opportunity with made up details and said Your Test Records Are Ready! Core action, an estimate, a project and a task, from 14:13 to 14:17, about 4 minutes: estimate EST. #5 Test Kitchen Remodel got three manual items, cabinet installation 2 sets at $1,200, demolition labor 16 hours at $65 (the app said Labor cannot be Lump Sum in Estimate or SOV) and a quartz countertop at $3,400, for Total w/Tax: $6,840.00; it was not sent. Project TEST-001 was created for the test customer. Basic has no daily log or scheduling module (the feature list is Projects, To-Do's, Estimates, Invoices, Payments, Expenses, Takeoffs, Directory, Leads, Calendar, Files & Photos, Reports and Notes), so a To-Do was added to the project instead. Files & Photos holds sample folders and files; nothing was uploaded and Google Drive and Dropbox were not connected. Plans: Manage Subscription showed Current Plan: Basic: Annual Subscription, In Trial, Plan Amount $588.00, Started 11/19/2026, Trial Ends 12/19/2026 12:03 AM UTC, No Payments Processed, and that charges appear from the payment processor as PADDLE*CONTRFORMN. User Count 1, Users Available 0. Checkout: the trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen. Cancelling, done the same day: Settings, Manage Subscription, Cancel. Screen 1 asks why (we chose Couldn't Figure it Out); screen 2 offers Extend Trial By 14 Days (declined); screen 3 asks Anything we could have done better? with at least 45 characters (we typed a sentence about testing); screen 4, Final Confirmation, warns that you lose your data and offers a 1:1 session. No password. After Confirm & Cancel a seven-question Cancellation Request survey follows (reasons, ratings, would you come back, an optional feedback call for a $25 gift card); after Submit the app signs you out. Confirmation came by e-mail from Paddle, Subscription scheduled to cancel: Your trial will end on 19 Dec 2026, Basic (1 User) Annual, Amount $711.48/year (inc. tax). So the trial stays usable until 19 December and the annual charge is stopped; with tax the $588 plan is $711.48 for a Dutch buyer. Not tested: daily logs and scheduling, invoices and payments, QuickBooks, the client portal, invitations, more users and other plans. Clean up: the test customer, estimate EST. #5, project TEST-001 and the To-Do stay. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: A phone number is required at sign-up, and set-up asks several required questions before you can start. Basic has no daily log or scheduling module. The annual price is shown without tax: $588 became $711.48 for a Dutch buyer. Cancelling needs a reason of at least 45 characters and a seven-question survey.

Core action, an estimate, a project and a task, from 14:13 to 14:17, about 4 minutes: estimate EST. #5 Test Kitchen Remodel got three manual items, cabinet installation 2 sets at $1,200, demolition labor 16 hours at $65 (the app said Labor cannot be Lump Sum in Estimate or SOV) and a quartz countertop at $3,400, for Total w/Tax: $6,840.00; it was not sent. Project TEST-001 was created for the test customer. Basic has no daily log or scheduling module (the feature list is Projects, To-Do's, Estimates, Invoices, Payments, Expenses, Takeoffs, Directory, Leads, Calendar, Files & Photos, Reports and Notes), so a To-Do was added to the project instead. Files & Photos holds sample folders and files; nothing was uploaded and Google Drive and Dropbox were not connected. Plans: Manage Subscription showed Current Plan: Basic: Annual Subscription, In Trial, Plan Amount $588.00, Started 11/19/2026, Trial Ends 12/19/2026 12:03 AM UTC, No Payments Processed, and that charges appear from the payment processor as PADDLE*CONTRFORMN. User Count 1, Users Available 0. Checkout: the trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen. Cancelling, done the same day: Settings, Manage Subscription, Cancel. Screen 1 asks why (we chose Couldn't Figure it Out); screen 2 offers Extend Trial By 14 Days (declined); screen 3 asks Anything we could have done better? with at least 45 characters (we typed a sentence about testing); screen 4, Final Confirmation, warns that you lose your data and offers a 1:1 session. No password. After Confirm & Cancel a seven-question Cancellation Request survey follows (reasons, ratings, would you come back, an optional feedback call for a $25 gift card); after Submit the app signs you out. Confirmation came by e-mail from Paddle, Subscription scheduled to cancel: Your trial will end on 19 Dec 2026, Basic (1 User) Annual, Amount $711.48/year (inc. tax). So the trial stays usable until 19 December and the annual charge is stopped; with tax the $588 plan is $711.48 for a Dutch buyer. Not tested: daily logs and scheduling, invoices and payments, QuickBooks, the client portal, invitations, more users and other plans. Clean up: the test customer, estimate EST. #5, project TEST-001 and the To-Do stay. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: A phone number is required at sign-up, and set-up asks several required questions before you can start. Basic has no daily log or scheduling module. The annual price is shown without tax: $588 became $711.48 for a Dutch buyer. Cancelling needs a reason of at least 45 characters and a seven-question survey.
